claims.claim: Neatly used Lumix G7 mirrorless camera.
claims.evidence: Photos show a Lumix G7 body with lens, but condition level ('neatly used') is subjective and not verifiable remotely.
Photo 1 shows two battery packs and a charger unit next to the camera.

risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy wear or hidden defects (buttons, dials, sensor, overheating) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and a short recording test; also ask for shutter count screenshot (or service report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera with unknown shutter count and potential faults (worst-case: not fully reliable).

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus, scratches, haze) and autofocus performance not shown clearly.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lens glass (front and rear) under light, plus a short autofocus test video on a subject at near and far distances.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens may have optical issues or weak AF (worst-case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Charger/batteries health (batteries may not hold charge; charger may be incompatible or faulty).
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing charging in progress and the battery percentage/charge level changing, then a test shot after full charge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as batteries/charger may be weak or unreliable (worst-case: batteries not holding charge).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or wrong bundle (e.g., no original charger, no cable, no strap, no memory card).
risks.proof: Ask for a full list of included items and a photo spread of everything included (cables, strap, manuals, memory card if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as only what’s shown (camera + lens + 2 batteries + charger), with no extra accessories.

proof_requests: Power-on video + menu navigation (showing no error messages).
Lens glass close-ups (front and rear) under bright light.
Autofocus test video (near + far) and a sample photo taken.
Charging test clip showing battery charging and then a working test shot.
response.reason: The photos confirm a Panasonic Lumix G7 body with lens and show 2 batteries plus a charger, but key value drivers (sensor/lens condition, shutter count, battery health, and full functionality) are not verifiable from these images alone.
